unmount.evidence: unmount -> 0, and the file no longer opens afterwards

return_to_stock_chain.evidence: every run ended with a byte-equal 64 MiB read-back; return-gate state=2 allowed=1

unmount_root_cause.why: withref=1 tells dounmount the caller holds a reference to give back, and it calls mount_drop early. No such reference was held, so the mount's count went negative and the call never returned.
ruled_out_first: timeout (raised 150 s to 420 s; timestamps stopped at 166 s)
dounmount returning by itself (no loader_return in apfs_vfsops.c or vfs_syscalls.c)
unmount_root_cause.lesson: three wrong hypotheses all searched outside the function; the fault was the meaning of an argument

errors_fixed_this_phase: device node made in the character namespace on a block major
ioctl copied the argument in again after VOP_IOCTL had already done it
the mount opened the vnode the calling program still held (EBUSY)
getdirentries64's fourth argument is an out-parameter; 0 caused EFAULT
